chapter: Opening and early New Orleans customs
title: Catholic and Protestant musicians in funeral bands; fees and Tulane advertising
summary: He names the standard funeral bands (Moret's Excelsior, Celestin's Tuxedo, Perez's Onward, Eureka), says funerals paid $3, and tells of advertising for Tulane football.
